title: Kakino stone circle with magnetic anomalies from lightning

tellings.quote: this exact same thing at a site called Kakino where it's a tough hillside.

plain: A researcher of ancient sites named Geoffrey Drumm, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes a stone circle on a steep hillside at a place called Kakino in Japan. Drumm says it shows the exact same thing he has found at other ancient sites: magnetic anomalies in the ground that he attributes to lightning strikes. He tells it because, if true, it would suggest ancient builders around the world chose or used places tied to electrical forces.
